title: Patriarchal Household
summary: A patriarchal household included extended family, servants, tents, flocks, property, and covenant responsibilities under household leadership.
background: In Genesis, “household” language is broader than a modern nuclear family. It includes kinship networks, servants, inheritance, protection, worship, and family obligations.
teachingHelp: Clarify that household decisions shaped family, faith, inheritance, and covenant life. This helps explain Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph narratives.
